consumer: An offline combat-log analysis script reading each monster's exported current HP integer to do arithmetic over damage; it asks 'what is this monster's true current HP value?' and holds it as raw state, not a yes/no it computes nor a thing the engine displays.
scope: Per-monster raw current-HP state for the nearby/exported monsters; no broader predicate or map-region reach needed.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) writes mon.get_hp()/mon.get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot, i.e. the authoritative raw HP integer, not a computed predicate or a formatted/filtered display proxy.
divergence: A monster just took damage so its true mon.get_hp() dropped (e.g. 18->6), but a remembered/last-drawn HP-bar display proxy still reflects the pre-hit value; the script that needs the ground-truth integer would be wrong if it consumed the display proxy instead of raw get_hp().
